title: Lakshmana kills Atikaya
introduction: Seeing Atikaya, the colossal demon, coming towards him on a chariot, Rama asks Vibhishana who he is Vibhishana introduces Atikaya, as being a son of Ravana and Dhanyamali (another consort of Ravana). When some commanders of monkeys try to attack Atikaya, he chops off trees and crags hurled at him. Without fighting further with the monkeys, Atikaya, moves forward to Rama and challenges him for a fight. Then Lakshmana with his bow and arrows begins to fight with Atikaya. By a sharp arrow struck by Atikaya in Lakshmana's chest, Lakshmana is enraged and releases an arrow employed with a missile of fire and Atikaya attacks it with an arrow employed with a solar missile. On the advice the wind-god appeared before him, Lakshmana finally hurls an arrow employed with a missile of Brahma and chips off the head of Atikaya.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 71st chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
स्वबलम् व्यथितम् दृष्ट्वा तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् |
भ्रातॄंश्च निहतान्दृष्ट्वा शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान्
पितृव्यौ चापि सन्दृश्य समरे संनिषूदितौ |
युद्धोन्मत्तम् च मत्तम् च भ्रातरौ राक्षसर्षभौ
चुकोप च महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तवरो युधि |
अतिकायोऽद्रिसङ्काशो देवदानवदर्पहा
verses.iast:
svabalam vyathitam dṛṣṭvā tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam |
bhrātṝṃśca nihatāndṛṣṭvā śakratulyaparākramān
pitṛvyau cāpi sandṛśya samare saṃniṣUditau |
yuddhonmattam ca mattam ca bhrātarau rākṣasarṣabhau
cukopa ca mahātejā brahmadattavaro yudhi |
atikāyo'drisañkāśo devadānavadarpahā
verses.translation: Seeing his own army making a tumultuous sound tottering with excessive fear, seeing his brothers having a prowess equal to that of Indra the lord of celestials having been killed, and seeing his paternal uncles as also Yuddhonmatta and Matta (Mahodara and Mahaparshva) his brothers and the foremost of demons having been fallen down, Atikaya of great splendour, having boons bestowed by Brahma the lord of creation, having appearance of a mountain and who removed the pride of celestials and ogres, was enraged.

glosses.meaning: having a prowess equal to that of Indra the lord of celestials
having boons bestowed by Brahma the lord of creation
and who removed the pride of celestials and ogres

verses.devanagari:
स भास्करसहस्रस्य सङ्घातमिव भास्वरम् |
रथमास्थाय शक्रारिरभिदुद्राव वानरान्
verses.iast:
sa bhāskarasahasrasya sañghātamiva bhāsvaram |
rathamāsthāya śakrārirabhidudrāva vānarān
verses.translation: That Atikaya, the enemy of Indra the lord of celestials, mounting a chariot shining like a cluster of thousand suns, ran towards the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: the enemy of Indra the lord of celestials
like a cluster of thousand suns

verses.devanagari:
स विस्फार्य तदा चापम् किरीटी मृष्टकुण्डलः |
नाम संश्रावयामास ननाद च महास्वनम्
verses.iast:
sa visphārya tadā cāpam kirīṭī mṛṣṭakuṇḍalaḥ |
nāma saṃśrāvayāmāsa nanāda ca mahāsvanam
verses.translation: Wearing a crown and well-cleansed ear-rings as also drawing his bow, he roared with a big noise, making his name loudly heard.

verses.devanagari:
तेन सिम्हप्रणादेन नामविश्रावणेन च |
ज्याशब्देन च भीमेन त्रासयामास वानरान्
verses.iast:
tena simhapraṇādena nāmaviśrāvaṇena ca |
jyāśabdena ca bhīmena trāsayāmāsa vānarān
verses.translation: By that lion-like roar, making his name loudly heard and by that terrific sound of the bow-string, it created terror to the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: and by that terrific sound of the bow-string

verses.devanagari:
ते दृष्ट्वा देहमाहात्म्यम् कुम्भकर्णोऽयमुत्थितः |
भयार्ता वानराः सर्वे संश्रयन्ते परस्परम्
verses.iast:
te dṛṣṭvā dehamāhātmyam kumbhakarṇo'yamutthitaḥ |
bhayārtā vānarāḥ sarve saṃśrayante parasparam
verses.translation: Seeing the bulkiness of his body, all the monkeys, thinking that Kumbhakarna woke up again, took refuge with each other, afflicted as they were, with fear.

verses.devanagari:
ते तस्य रूपमालोक्य यथा विष्णोस्त्रिविक्रमे |
भयाद्वानरयोधास्ते विद्रवन्ति ततस्ततः
verses.iast:
te tasya rūpamālokya yathā viṣṇostrivikrame |
bhayādvānarayodhāste vidravanti tatastataḥ
verses.translation: Seeing his form appearing like Vishnu who strided over the three worlds in three steps, the those renowned monkey-warriors with fear, ran away hither and thither.

glosses.meaning: who strided over the three worlds in three steps

verses.devanagari:
तेऽतिकायम् समासाद्य वानरा मूढचेतसः |
शरण्यम् शरणम् जग्मुर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजमाहवे
verses.iast:
te'tikāyam samāsādya vānarā mūḍhacetasaḥ |
śaraṇyam śaraṇam jagmurlakṣmaṇāgrajamāhave
verses.translation: When Atikaya was to be attacked, the monkeys were bewildered in mind and sought in the battle, a refuge with Rama, who affords protection.

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽतिकायम् काकुत्स्थो रथस्थं पर्वतोपमम् |
ददर्श धन्विनम् दूराद्गर्जन्तं कालमेघवत्
verses.iast:
tato'tikāyam kākutstho rathasthaṃ parvatopamam |
dadarśa dhanvinam dūrādgarjantaṃ kālameghavat
verses.translation: Then, Rama saw from a distance, Atikaya, who resembled a mountain in size, stationed in a chariot, armed with a bow and rumbling like a cloud appearing at the time of universal dissolution.

verses.devanagari:
स तम् दृष्ट्वा महाकायम् राघवस्तु सुविस्मितः |
वानरान्सान्त्वयित्वा च विभीषणमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
sa tam dṛṣṭvā mahākāyam rāghavastu suvismitaḥ |
vānarānsāntvayitvā ca vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Seeing that Atikaya, having a colossal body, Rama for his part was quite surprised and after consoling the monkeys, spoke to Vibhishana (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
कोऽसौ पर्वतसङ्काशो धनुष्मान्हरिलोचनः |
युक्ते हयसहस्रेण विशाले स्यन्दने स्थितः
verses.iast:
ko'sau parvatasañkāśo dhanuṣmānharilocanaḥ |
yukte hayasahasreṇa viśāle syandane sthitaḥ
verses.translation: "Who is he, resembling a mountain in size, armed with a bow, brown-eyed and seated in a spacious chariot yoked with a thousand horses?"

verses.devanagari:
य एष निशितैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैः प्रासतोमरैः |
अर्चिष्मद्भिर्वृतो भाति भूतैरिव महेश्वरः
verses.iast:
ya eṣa niśitaiḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ prāsatomaraiḥ |
arciṣmadbhirvṛto bhāti bhūtairiva maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He is shining like Lord Shiva surrounded by genii, with resplendent and sharp spikes, with very sharply barbed javelins and lances.

verses.devanagari:
कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिर्य एषोऽभिविराजते |
आवृतो रथशक्तीभिर्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः
verses.iast:
kālajihvāprakāśābhirya eṣo'bhivirājate |
āvṛto rathaśaktībhirvidyudbhiriva toyadaḥ
verses.translation: "He is shining like a lightening cloud and moving round with staffs which support the banners of the war-chariot, appearing like tongues of the Time-Sprit."

glosses.meaning: with staffs which support the banners of the war-chariot
with appearances of tongues of the time-spirit.

verses.devanagari:
धनूंसि चास्य सज्यानि हेमपृष्ठानि सर्वशः |
शोभयन्ति रथश्रेष्ठम् शक्रपातमिवाम्बरम्
verses.iast:
dhanūṃsi cāsya sajyAni hemapṛṣṭhāni sarvaśaḥ |
śobhayanti rathaśreṣṭham śakrapātamivāmbaram
verses.translation: "Bows adhered with golden backs in his excellent chariot are shining on all sides like a rainbow in the sky."

verses.devanagari:
य एष रक्षः शार्दूलो रणभूमिम् विराजयन् |
अभ्येति रथिनाम् श्रेष्ठो रथेनादित्यतेजसा
ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेन राहुणाभिविराजते |
सूर्यरश्मिप्रभैर्बाणैर्दिशो दश विराजयन्
verses.iast:
ya eṣa rakṣaḥ śārdūlo raṇabhūmim virājayan |
abhyeti rathinām śreṣṭho rathenādityatejasā
dhvajaśṛñgapratiṣṭhena rāhuṇābhivirājate |
sūryaraśmiprabhairbāṇairdiśo daśa virājayan
verses.translation: "That warrior of demons, the eminent of charioteers, making the battle-front to shine, is coming in a chariot with the splendour of the sun, with arrows having gleams of sun-beams, shining in ten directions and embellishing brilliance by an emblem of Rahu installed on the point of his standard."

glosses.meaning: installed on the point of his standard.

verses.devanagari:
त्रिणतं मेघनिर्ह्रादम् हेमपृष्ठमलङ्कृतम् |
शतक्रतुधनुःप्रख्यम् धनुश्चास्य विराजते
verses.iast:
triṇataṃ meghanirhrādam hemapṛṣṭhamalañkṛtam |
śatakratudhanuḥprakhyam dhanuścāsya virājate
verses.translation: "His triply curved, golden backed and decorated bow, having a rumbling sound of the cloud, is shining like a rain-bow."

glosses.meaning: having a rumbling sound of the cloud

verses.devanagari:
सध्वजः सपताकश्च सानुकर्षो महारथः |
चतुःसादिसमायुक्तो मेघस्तनितनिस्वनः
verses.iast:
sadhvajaḥ sapatākaśca sānukarṣo mahārathaḥ |
catuḥsādisamāyukto meghastanitanisvanaḥ
verses.translation: "His large chariot, with its flag and emblem, with its axle-tree at the bottom, and having the sound of a cloud's lightning, consists of four charioteers."

glosses.meaning: with its axle-tree at the bottom
having the sound of a cloud's lightning

verses.devanagari:
विंशतिर्दश चाष्टौ च तूणीररथमास्थिताः |
कार्मुकाणि च भीमानि ज्याश्च काञ्चनपिङ्गलाः
verses.iast:
viṃśatirdaśa cāṣṭau ca tūṇīrarathamāsthitāḥ |
kārmukāṇi ca bhīmāni jyāśca kāñcanapiñgalāḥ
verses.translation: Twenty quivers, ten terrific bows and eight bow-strings, golden and reddish brown in colour, are abiding in his chariot."

glosses.meaning: golden and reddish brown in colour

verses.devanagari:
द्वौ च खड्गौ रथगतौ पार्श्वस्थौ पार्श्वशोभिनौ |
चतुर्हस्तत्सरुचितौ व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ
verses.iast:
dvau ca khaḍgau rathagatau pārśvasthau pārśvaśobhinau |
caturhastatsarucitau vyaktahastadaśāyatau
verses.translation: "On that chariot are hanging two swords, clearly measuring ten cubits in length and provided with measuring four cubits, casting their splendour on his two sides."

glosses.meaning: clearly measuring ten cubits in length
shone upon by hilts measuring four cubits

verses.devanagari:
रक्तकण्ठगुणो धीरो महापर्वतसंनिभः |
कालः कालमहावक्त्रो मेघस्थ इव भास्करः
verses.iast:
raktakaṇṭhaguṇo dhīro mahāparvatasaṃnibhaḥ |
kālaḥ kālamahāvaktro meghastha iva bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: "This brave warrior, with a red garland adorning his neck, resembling a large mountain black in colour and having a month as large as Death, looks like the sun veiled by a cloud."

glosses.meaning: with a red garland adorning his neck
having a mouth as large as Death

verses.devanagari:
काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्यां भुजाभ्यामेष शोभते |
शृङ्गाभ्यामिव तुङ्गाभ्याम् हिमवान्पर्वतोत्तमः
verses.iast:
kāñcanāñgadanaddhābhyāṃ bhujābhyāmeṣa śobhate |
śṛñgābhyāmiva tuñgābhyām himavānparvatottamaḥ
verses.translation: "With his arms adorned with gold armlets, he shines like the Himalaya, the highest mountain with its two lofty peaks."

glosses.meaning: like the Himalaya parvatottamaH = the highest mountain

verses.devanagari:
कुण्डलाभ्याम् तु यस्यैतद्भाति वक्त्रम् शुभेक्षणम् |
पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतं पूर्णबिम्बमिवैन्दवम्
verses.iast:
kuṇḍalābhyām tu yasyaitadbhāti vaktram śubhekṣaṇam |
punarvasvantaragataṃ pūrṇabimbamivaindavam
verses.translation: "His awfully dreadful face, with two ear-rings, is shining like a full moon appearing between the two stars constituting the constellation, Punnarvasu."

glosses.meaning: appearing between the two stars constituting the constellation

verses.devanagari:
आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो त्वमेनम् राक्षसोत्तमम् |
यम् दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे भयार्ता विद्रूता दिशः
verses.iast:
ācakṣva me mahābāho tvamenam rākṣasottamam |
yam dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve bhayārtā vidrūtā diśaḥ
verses.translation: "O the long armed! Tell me who this foremost of demons is! On seeing him all the monkeys, afflicted with fear, are running away in different directions."

verses.devanagari:
स पृष्ठो राजपुत्रेण रामेणामिततेजसा |
आचचक्षे महातेजा राघवाय विभीषणः
verses.iast:
sa pṛṣṭho rājaputreṇa rāmeṇāmitatejasā |
ācacakṣe mahātejā rāghavāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thus asked by Rama, the prince having an unlimited splendour, that Vibhishana of great brilliance, replied to Rama as follows:

verses.devanagari:
दशग्रीवो महातेजा राजा वैश्रवणानुजः |
भीमकर्मा महोत्साहो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः
verses.iast:
daśagrīvo mahātejā rājā vaiśravaṇānujaḥ |
bhīmakarmā mahotsāho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
verses.translation: "The ten-necked king Ravana, having great brilliance, the brother of Kubera the lord of wealth, doing terrific deeds and possessing a great power, is the lord of demons."

glosses.meaning: the brother of Kumbera the lord of wealth

verses.devanagari:
तस्यासीद्वीर्यवान्पुत्रो रावणप्रतिमो रणे |
वृद्धसेवी श्रुतधरः सर्वास्त्रविदुषाम् वरः
verses.iast:
tasyāsīdvīryavānputro rāvaṇapratimo raṇe |
vṛddhasevī śrutadharaḥ sarvāstraviduṣām varaḥ
verses.translation: "To him, there is a valiant son, equal to Ravana in combat, who serves elders, holding that which is heard from them and skilled in the use of weaponry."

glosses.meaning: among those holding that which is heard
and who is skilled in the use of weaponry.

verses.devanagari:
अश्वपृष्ठे रथे नागे खड्गे धनुषि कर्षणे |
भेदे सान्त्वे च दाने च नये मन्त्रे च संमतः
verses.iast:
aśvapṛṣṭhe rathe nāge khaḍge dhanuṣi karṣaṇe |
bhede sāntve ca dāne ca naye mantre ca saṃmataḥ
verses.translation: "He is respected for his counsel, for his rides on the backs of horses and elephants, for his drawing out of the sword and the bow, for his strategy winning over to his side by sowing dissention negotiation and bribery and for his steering capacity of an army.

glosses.meaning: for his rides on a horse-back
for his drawing out of sword and bow
for his strategy of winning over to his side by sowing dissention
and for his steering capacity of an army.

verses.devanagari:
यस्य बाहुम् समाश्रित्य लङ्का भवति निर्भया |
तनयम् धान्यमालिन्या अतिकायमिमम् विदुः
verses.iast:
yasya bāhum samāśritya lañkā bhavati nirbhayā |
tanayam dhānyamālinyā atikāyamimam viduḥ
verses.translation: "He is Atikaya, the son of Dhanyamali. Lanka is feeling fearless, by resting on his arm."

verses.devanagari:
एतेनाराधितो ब्रह्मा तपसा भावितात्मना |
अस्त्राणि चाप्यवाप्तानि रिपवश्च पराजिताः
verses.iast:
etenārādhito brahmā tapasā bhāvitātmanā |
astrāṇi cāpyavāptāni ripavaśca parājitāḥ
verses.translation: "He, who purified his soul by meditating on the universal soul, worshipped Brahma the lord of creation, obtained missiles too and conquered the enemies.

glosses.meaning: who purified his soul by meditating on the universal soul

verses.devanagari:
सुरासुरैरवध्यत्वम् दत्तमस्मै स्वयम्भुवा |
एतच्च कवचम् दिव्यम् रथश्चैषोऽर्कभास्करः
verses.iast:
surāsurairavadhyatvam dattamasmai svayambhuvā |
etacca kavacam divyam rathaścaiṣo'rkabhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: "Brahma, the lord of creation, granted a boon, exempting him from death at the hands of celestials and demons as also this wonderful armour and the chariot shining like the sun."

verses.devanagari:
एतेन शतशो देवा दानवाश्च पराजिताः |
रक्षितानि च रक्षामि यक्षाश्चापि निषूदिताः
verses.iast:
etena śataśo devā dānavāśca parājitāḥ |
rakṣitāni ca rakṣāmi yakṣāścāpi niṣūditāḥ
verses.translation: "He conquered the celestials and the ogres several times, destroyed Yakshas the supernatural beings and defended the demons."

glosses.meaning: even Yakshas the super natural beings

verses.devanagari:
वज्रम् विष्टम्भितं येन बाणैरिन्द्रस्य धीमतः |
पाशः सलिलराजस्य युद्धे प्रतिहतस्तथा
एषोऽतिकायो बलवान् राक्षसानामथर्षभः |
स रावणस्य सुतो धीमान् देवदनव दर्पहा
verses.iast:
vajram viṣṭambhitaṃ yena bāṇairindrasya dhīmataḥ |
pāśaḥ salilarājasya yuddhe pratihatastathā
eṣo'tikāyo balavān rākṣasānāmatharṣabhaḥ |
sa rāvaṇasya suto dhīmān devadanava darpahā
verses.translation: "He is Atikaya, who paralyzed the thunderbolt of the intelligent Indra with his arrows. He struck down the noose of Varuna, the seizer of transgressors. This wise Ravana's son, who is strong and the foremost of demons took off the pride of celestials and ogres."

glosses.meaning: who took off the pride from celestials and ogres.

verses.devanagari:
तदस्मिन् क्रियताम् यत्नः क्षिप्रं पुरुषपुङ्गव |
पुरा वानरसैन्यानि क्षयं नयति सायकैः
verses.iast:
tadasmin kriyatām yatnaḥ kṣipraṃ puruṣapuñgava |
purā vānarasainyāni kṣayaṃ nayati sāyakaiḥ
verses.translation: "O Rama, the foremost of men! Therefore let the effort to destroy him be made quickly. Otherwise shortly, he will bring in destruction for our army of monkeys, with his arrows."

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽतिकायो बलवान्प्रविश्य हरिवाहिनीम् |
विस्फारयामास धनुर्ननाद च पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
tato'tikāyo balavAnpraviśya harivāhinīm |
visphārayāmāsa dhanurnanāda ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Entering the army of monkeys, the strong Atikaya then stretched his bow and roared again and again.

verses.devanagari:
तं भीमवपुषम् दृष्ट्वा रथस्थम् रथिनां वरम् |
अभिपेतुर्महात्मानो ये प्रधानाः ये वनौकसः
verses.iast:
taṃ bhīmavapuṣam dṛṣṭvā rathastham rathināṃ varam |
abhipeturmahātmāno ye pradhānāḥ ye vanaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing him with a terrific body, seated in the chariot, as the excellent one among the charioteers, powerful chiefs of monkeys rushed towards him.

verses.devanagari:
कुमुदो द्विविदो मैन्दो नीलः शरभ एव च |
पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश् च युगपत्समभिद्रवन्
verses.iast:
kumudo dvivido maindo nīlaḥ śarabha eva ca |
pādapairgiriśṛñgaiś ca yugapatsamabhidravan
verses.translation: Taking trees and mountain peaks, Kumuda, Dvivida, Mainda, Nila and Sharabha marched forwards quickly to attack him at once.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् वृक्षांश्च शैलांश्च शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः |
अतिकायो महातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदाम् वरः
verses.iast:
teṣām vṛkṣāṃśca śailāṃśca śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
atikāyo mahātejāścicchedāstravidām varaḥ
verses.translation: Atikaya of great splendour, the foremost among those skilled in weaponry, chopped off their trees and crags with his arrows decked with gold.

glosses.meaning: the foremost among those skilled in weaponry

verses.devanagari:
तांश्चैव सरान्स हरीञ्शरैः सर्वायसैर्बली |
विव्याधाभिमुखः सङ्ख्ये भीमकायो निशाचरः
verses.iast:
tāṃścaiva sarānsa harīñśaraiḥ sarvāyasairbalī |
vivyādhābhimukhaḥ sañkhye bhīmakāyo niśācaraḥ
verses.translation: That strong and skilled Atikaya with a terrific body, struck all those monkeys, facing in front of him in battle with arrows fully made of iron.

verses.devanagari:
तेऽर्दिता बाणबर्षेण भिन्नगात्राः प्लवङ्गमाः |
न शेकुरतिकायस्य प्रतिकर्तुं महारणे
verses.iast:
te'rditā bāṇabarṣeṇa bhinnagātrāḥ plavañgamāḥ |
na śekuratikāyasya pratikartuṃ mahāraṇe
verses.translation: Those overthrown monkeys, injured with their blown out bodies, by the shower of Atikaya's arrows in that great battle, were unable to retaliate on him.

verses.devanagari:
तत्सैन्यम् हरिवीराणाम् त्रासयामास राक्षसः |
मृगयूथमिव क्रुद्धो हरिर्यौवनमास्थितः
verses.iast:
tatsainyam harivīrāṇām trāsayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ |
mṛgayūthamiva kruddho hariryauvanamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: That demon, who was arrogant of his youth, frightened that army of monkey-warriors, as an enraged lion frightens a herd of deers.

glosses.meaning: who was arrogant of his youth
as an enraged lion (frightens) mR^igayuuthamiva = a herd of deers.

verses.devanagari:
स राषसेन्द्रो हरिसैन्यमध्ये |
नायुध्यमानं निजघान कम् चित् |
उपेत्य रामम् सधनुः कलापी |
सगर्वितम् वाक्यमिदं बभाषे
verses.iast:
sa rāṣasendro harisainyamadhye |
nāyudhyamānaṃ nijaghāna kam cit |
upetya rāmam sadhanuḥ kalāpī |
sagarvitam vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe
verses.translation: That chief of demons did not strike whomsoever of the monkey-warriors who were unable to fight. That Atikaya, with his bow and quiver of arrows, going up quickly towards Rama, spoke haughty words (to him) as follows:

glosses.meaning: with his bow and quiver of arrows

verses.devanagari:
रथे स्थितोऽहम् शरचापपाणि |
न प्राकृतम् कं चन योधयामि |
यस्यास्ति शक्तिर्व्यवसाय युक्ता |
ददातुं मे क्षिप्रमिहाद्य युद्धम्
verses.iast:
rathe sthito'ham śaracāpapāṇi |
na prākṛtam kaṃ cana yodhayāmi |
yasyāsti śaktirvyavasāya yuktā |
dadātuṃ me kṣipramihādya yuddham
verses.translation: "I am seated in the chariot with arrows and a bow in my hand. I would not give battle with any common warrior. He who has ability and energy can give his fight to me now and here quickly."

glosses.meaning: with arrows and bow in my hand

verses.devanagari:
तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य |
चुकोप सौमित्रिरमित्रहन्ता |
अमृष्यमाणश्च समुत्पपात |
जग्राह चापम् च ततः स्मयित्वा
verses.iast:
tattasya vākyaṃ bruvato niśamya |
cukopa saumitriramitrahantā |
amṛṣyamāṇaśca samutpapāta |
jagrāha cāpam ca tataḥ smayitvā
verses.translation: Hearing his words, Lakshmana the annihilator of enemies was enraged. Then, unable to bear his words and smiling, he rose up quickly and took up his bow.

glosses.meaning: those of his words thus spoken
and unable to bear his words

verses.devanagari:
क्रुद्धः सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य तूणादाक्षिप्य सायकम् |
पुरस्तादतिकायस्य विचकर्ष महद्धनुः
verses.iast:
kruddhaḥ saumitrirutpatya tūṇādākṣipya sāyakam |
purastādatikāyasya vicakarṣa mahaddhanuḥ
verses.translation: The enraged Lakshmana, coming forward quickly and taking off an arrow from his quiver pulled out his great bow in front of Atikaya.

verses.devanagari:
पूरयन्स महीम् शैलानाकाशं सागरम् दिशः |
ज्याशब्दो लक्ष्मणस्योग्रस्त्रासयन्रजनीचरान्
verses.iast:
pūrayansa mahīm śailānākāśaṃ sāgaram diśaḥ |
jyāśabdo lakṣmaṇasyograstrāsayanrajanīcarān
verses.translation: That twang of the bow of Lakshmana, filling the entire quarters, earth, sky and the ocean, was angry, frightening the demons.

verses.devanagari:
सौमित्रेश्चापनिर्घोषम् श्रुत्वा प्रतिभयम् तदा |
विसिष्मिये महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली
verses.iast:
saumitreścāpanirghoṣam śrutvā pratibhayam tadā |
visiṣmiye mahātejā rākṣasendrātmajo balī
verses.translation: Hearing the terrific twang of Lakshmana's bow, the strong Atikaya of great splendour, was surprised.

verses.devanagari:
तदातिकायः कुपितो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमुत्थितम् |
आदाय निशितं बाणमिदम् वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tadātikāyaḥ kupito dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamutthitam |
ādāya niśitaṃ bāṇamidam vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Seeing Lakshmana standing in front of him for the battle, Atikaya then was enraged and taking a sharp arrow, spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
बालस्त्वमसि सौमित्रे विक्रमेष्वविचक्षणः |
गच्छ किम् कालसदृशं माम् योधयितुमिच्छसि
verses.iast:
bālastvamasi saumitre vikrameṣvavicakṣaṇaḥ |
gaccha kim kālasadṛśaṃ mām yodhayitumicchasi
verses.translation: "O Lakshmana! You are still a boy. You are ignorant of a fight. Why do you wish to fight with me, who is like Yama the Lord of Death? Go away."

glosses.meaning: who is like Yama the Lord of Death.

verses.devanagari:
न हि मद्बाहुसृष्टानामस्त्राणाम् हिमवानपि |
सोढुमुत्सहते वेगमन्तरिक्षमथो मही
verses.iast:
na hi madbāhusṛṣṭānāmastrāṇām himavānapi |
soḍhumutsahate vegamantarikṣamatho mahī
verses.translation: "Even the Himalayan Mountains or the sky or the earth would be unable to endure the speed of arrows released by my arms."

glosses.meaning: nor the sky nor the earth.

verses.devanagari:
सुखप्रसुप्तम् कालाग्निं प्रबोधयितुमिच्छसि |
न्यस्य चापं निवर्तस्व मा प्राणाञ्जहि मद्गतः
verses.iast:
sukhaprasuptam kālāgniṃ prabodhayitumicchasi |
nyasya cāpaṃ nivartasva mā prāṇāñjahi madgataḥ
verses.translation: "You wish to arouse a fire of dissolution, when it is sleeping happily. Placing your bow here, go back. Do not lose your life, by fighting against me."

glosses.meaning: a fire that is to destroy the world
having approached me with hostile intentions.

verses.devanagari:
अथ वा त्वं प्रतिष्टब्धो न निवर्तितुमिच्छसि |
तिष्ठ प्राणान्परित्यज्य गमिष्यसि यमक्षयम्
verses.iast:
atha vā tvaṃ pratiṣṭabdho na nivartitumicchasi |
tiṣṭha prāṇānparityajya gamiṣyasi yamakṣayam
verses.translation: "If you do not go back, with an obstinance, then you rather stay back. Abandoning your lives, you will reach the abode of Yama."

verses.devanagari:
पश्य मे निशितान् बाणान रिदर्पनिषूदनान् |
ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान्
verses.iast:
paśya me niśitān bāṇāna ridarpaniṣūdanān |
īśvarāyudhasañkāśāṃstaptakāñcanabhUṣaṇān
verses.translation: "See my sharp arrows decked with pure gold, which can remove the pride of my enemies and which are like the weapons of Ishvara the lord of destruction."

glosses.meaning: which can remove the pride of my enemies
which are like the weapons of Ishvara the lord destruction.

verses.devanagari:
एष ते सर्पसङ्काशो बाणः पास्यति शोणितम् |
मृगराज इव क्रुद्धो नागराजस्य शोणितम्
verses.iast:
eṣa te sarpasañkāśo bāṇaḥ pāsyati śoṇitam |
mṛgarāja iva kruddho nāgarājasya śoṇitam
verses.translation: "This arrow looking like a serpent will drink your blood as a lion drinks the blood of an elephant. "Thus speaking, Atikaya was enraged and fixed an arrow on his bow.

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वातिकायस्य वचः सरोषं |
सगर्वितम् सम्यति राजपुत्रः |
स सञ्चुकोपातिबलो मस्वी |
उवाच वाक्यम् च ततो महार्थम्
verses.iast:
śrutvātikāyasya vacaḥ saroṣaṃ |
sagarvitam samyati rājaputraḥ |
sa sañcukopātibalo masvī |
uvāca vākyam ca tato mahārtham
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Atikaya, filled with anger and arrogance in that battle-field, Lakshmana was enraged. Thereafter, that Lakshmana, having a great strength wisdom and great glory, also spoke as follows:

verses.devanagari:
न वाक्यमात्रेण भवान्प्रधानो |
न कत्थनात्सत्पुरुषा भवन्ति |
मयि स्थिते धन्विनि बाणपाणौ |
विदर्शयस्वात्मबलम् दुरात्मन्
verses.iast:
na vākyamātreṇa bhavānpradhāno |
na katthanātsatpuruṣā bhavanti |
mayi sthite dhanvini bāṇapāṇau |
vidarśayasvātmabalam durātman
verses.translation: "O the evil-minded! Just by uttering mere words, you cannot by a very important person. People cannot become good persons, just by boasting of themselves. You rather show your strength in me, who is standing with an arrow in hand and wielding a bow."

verses.devanagari:
कर्मणा सूचयात्मानं न विकत्थितुमर्हसि |
पौरुषेण तु यो युक्तः स तु शूर इति स्मृतः
verses.iast:
karmaṇā sūcayātmānaṃ na vikatthitumarhasi |
pauruṣeṇa tu yo yuktaḥ sa tu śūra iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "Reveal yourself by your deeds. You do not deserve to boast of yourself. A person with valour alone is declared as a warrior."

verses.devanagari:
सर्वायुधसमायुक्तो धन्वी त्वम् रथमास्थितः |
शरैर्वा यदि वाप्यस्त्रैर्दर्शयस्व पराक्रमम्
verses.iast:
sarvāyudhasamāyukto dhanvī tvam rathamāsthitaḥ |
śarairvā yadi vāpyastrairdarśayasva parākramam
verses.translation: "You are seated in a chariot, with all the weaponry and wielding a bow. Show your prowess either by your arrows or even by your weapons."

verses.devanagari:
ततः शिरस्ते निशितैः पातयिष्याम्यहम् शरैः |
मारुतः कालसम्पक्वम् वृन्तात्तालफलं यथा
verses.iast:
tataḥ śiraste niśitaiḥ pātayiṣyāmyaham śaraiḥ |
mārutaḥ kālasampakvam vṛntāttālaphalaṃ yathā
verses.translation: "Thereupon, with sharp arrows, I shall strike down your head like a fruit of a fan-palm, ripened by its time, is fallen down from its stalk by the gust of a wind."

glosses.meaning: as a fruit of a fan-palm

verses.devanagari:
अद्य ते मामका बाणास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः |
पास्यन्ति रुधिरम् गात्राद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम्
verses.iast:
adya te māmakā bāṇāstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ |
pāsyanti rudhiram gātrādbāṇaśalyāntarotthitam
verses.translation: "Today, these arrows of mine decked with pure gold, will drink blood oozing forth from the holes formed in your body by the sharp points of my arrows."

glosses.meaning: coming forth from the holes formed in your body by the sharp points of my arrows.

verses.devanagari:
बालोऽयमिति विज्ञाय न मावज्ञातुमर्हसि |
बालो वा यदि वा वृद्धो मृत्युम् जानीहि सम्युगे
बालेन विष्णुना लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्तास्त्रिविक्रमैः |
verses.iast:
bālo'yamiti viGYāya na māvaGYātumarhasi |
bālo vā yadi vā vṛddho mṛtyum jānīhi samyuge
bālena viṣṇunā lokāstrayaḥ krāntāstrivikramaiḥ |
verses.translation: "Thinking me to be a boy, you need not disregard me. Either as the boy or as the aged, you indeed know me in battle-front as the god of Death. Vishnu, as a boy occupied the three worlds just with his three strides, Didn't he?"

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत्परमार्थवत्
अतिकायः प्रचुक्रोध बाणम् चोत्तममाददे |
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā hetumatparamārthavat
atikāyaḥ pracukrodha bāṇam cottamamādade |
verses.translation: Hearing the reasonable and highly meaningful words of Lakshmana, Atikaya was very much enraged and took out an excellent arrow.

verses.devanagari:
ततो विद्याधरा भूता देवा दैत्या महर्षयः
गुह्यकाश्च महात्मानस्तद्युद्धम् ददृशुस्तदा |
verses.iast:
tato vidyādharā bhūtā devā daityā maharṣayaḥ
guhyakāśca mahātmānastadyuddham dadṛśustadā |
verses.translation: Then, Vidyadharas the supernatural beings, Bhutas the spirits, Devas the celestials, Daityas the demons, Maharshies the great sages and Guhyakas a class of demi-gods, all the great souled ones saw that battle.

glosses.meaning: Vidyadharas the supernatural beings bhuutaaH = Bhutas the spirits
Guhyakas a class of demi = gods

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽतिकायः कुपितश्चापमारोप्य सायकम्
लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिक्षेप सङ्क्षिपन्निव चाम्बरम् |
verses.iast:
tato'tikāyaḥ kupitaścāpamāropya sāyakam
lakṣmaṇasya pracikṣepa sañkṣipanniva cāmbaram |
verses.translation: Thereafter, the enraged Atikaya, stringing an arrow to his bow, dispatched it towards Lakshmana, as though he were shrinking up the space in between.

glosses.meaning: as though he were shrinking up the space in between.

verses.devanagari:
तमापतन्तं निशितम् शरमाशीविषोपमम्
अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा |
verses.iast:
tamāpatantaṃ niśitam śaramāśīviṣopamam
ardhacandreṇa ciccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā |
verses.translation: Lakshmana, the annihilator of enemy-warriors, chopped off that serpent-like sharp arrow, which was falling down on him, with his crescent-pointed arrow.

glosses.meaning: which was falling down on him

verses.devanagari:
तं निकृत्तम् शरम् दृष्ट्वा कृत्तभोगमिवोरगम्
अतिकायो भृशम् क्रुद्धः पञ्चबाणान्समाददे |
verses.iast:
taṃ nikṛttam śaram dṛṣṭvā kṛttabhogamivoragam
atikāyo bhṛśam kruddhaḥ pañcabāṇānsamādade |
verses.translation: Seeing that arrow which was chopped off as a snake's hood severed into pieces, Atikaya was very much enraged and fitted five arrows to his bow.

glosses.meaning: as a snake's hood severed into pieces

verses.devanagari:
ताञ्शरान्सम्प्रचिक्षेप लक्ष्मणाय निशाचरः
तानप्राप्ताञ्शरैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद भरतानुजः |
verses.iast:
tāñśarānsampracikṣepa lakṣmaṇāya niśācaraḥ
tānaprāptāñśaraistīkṣṇaiściccheda bharatānujaḥ |
verses.translation: That demon hurled those arrows towards Lakshmana. Even before they reached him, Lakshmana chopped them off with his sharp arrows.

verses.devanagari:
स तांश्छित्त्वा शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
आददे निशितं बाणम् ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा |
verses.iast:
sa tāṃśchittvā śaraistīkṣṇairlakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
ādade niśitaṃ bāṇam jvalantamiva tejasā |
verses.translation: Cutting off those arrows with his sharp arrows that Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy-warriors, took up a sharp arrow, as though it was blazing with a glow.

glosses.meaning: as though it was blazing with a glow.

verses.devanagari:
तमादाय धनुः श्रेष्ठे योजयामास लक्ष्मणः
विचकर्ष च वेगेन विससर्ज च सायकम् |
verses.iast:
tamādāya dhanuḥ śreṣṭhe yojayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ
vicakarṣa ca vegena visasarja ca sāyakam |
verses.translation: Taking that arrow, Lakshmana harnessed it on his excellent bow, stretched it with force and released it.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्णायतविसृष्टेन शरेणानत पर्वणा
ललाटे राक्षसश्रेष्ठमाजघान स वीर्यवान् |
verses.iast:
pūrṇāyatavisṛṣṭena śareṇānata parvaṇā
lalāṭe rākṣasaśreṣṭhamājaghāna sa vīryavān |
verses.translation: That valiant Lakshmana, by a flat-jointed arrow released fully, struck it on the forehead of that excellent demon.

verses.devanagari:
स ललाटे शरो मग्नस्तस्य भीमस्य रक्षसः
ददृशे शोणितेनाक्तः पन्नगेन्द्र इवाहवे |
verses.iast:
sa lalāṭe śaro magnastasya bhīmasya rakṣasaḥ
dadṛśe śoṇitenāktaḥ pannagendra ivāhave |
verses.translation: That arrow, sunken into the forehead of that terrible demon, smeared with blood, appeared like a serpent-king on a mountain.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसः प्रचकम्पे च लक्ष्मणेषु प्रकम्पितः
रुद्रबाणहतं भीमम् यथा त्रिपुरगोपुरम् |
verses.iast:
rākṣasaḥ pracakampe ca lakṣmaṇeṣu prakampitaḥ
rudrabāṇahataṃ bhīmam yathā tripuragopuram |
verses.translation: The demon, tormented by Lakshmana's arrow, then trembled violently as when the terrific town-gate of Tripura City, (built of gold, silver and iron in the sky, air and earth by Maya for the demons) was struck by Shiva's arrow.

glosses.meaning: like the terrific town-gate of Tripura City built of gold
struck by the arrow of Shiva.

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तयामास चाश्वस्य विमृश्य च महाबलः
साधु बाणनिपातेन श्वाघनीयोऽसि मे रिपुः |
verses.iast:
cintayāmāsa cāśvasya vimṛśya ca mahābalaḥ
sādhu bāṇanipātena śvāghanīyo'si me ripuḥ |
verses.translation: That demon of great strength, recovering his breath, reasoningly reflected as follows: "Well! By flying down an arrow, you have become a commendable enemy for me."

verses.devanagari:
विचार्यैवम् विनम्यास्यं विनम्य च भुजावुभौ
स रथोपस्थमास्थाय रथेन प्रचचार ह |
verses.iast:
vicāryaivam vinamyāsyaṃ vinamya ca bhujāvubhau
sa rathopasthamāsthāya rathena pracacāra ha |
verses.translation: Thus speaking with his mouth wide open, Atikaya bent down with his large shoulder, ascended the top of his chariot and roamed about hither and thither by his chariot.

verses.devanagari:
एकम् त्रीन्पञ्च सप्तेति सायकान्राक्षसर्षभः
आददे सन्दधे चापि विचकर्षोत्ससर्ज च |
verses.iast:
ekam trīnpañca sapteti sāyakānrākṣasarṣabhaḥ
ādade sandadhe cāpi vicakarṣotsasarja ca |
verses.translation: Atikaya, the foremost of demons, seized hold of one, three, five and seven arrows and fixed them to his bow, stretched it and released the arrows.

glosses.meaning: fixing the arrows to the bow

verses.devanagari:
ते बाणाः कालसङ्काशा राक्षसेन्द्रधनुश्च्युताः
हेमपुङ्खा रविप्रख्याश्चक्रुर्दीप्तमिवाम्बरम् |
verses.iast:
te bāṇāḥ kālasañkāśā rākṣasendradhanuścyutāḥ
hemapuñkhā raviprakhyāścakrurdīptamivāmbaram |
verses.translation: Those arrows, released from the bow of Atikaya, the leader of demons, appearing as Death, with golden shafts and shining like the sun, set the sky ablaze.

glosses.meaning: released from the bow of the leader of demons

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तान्राक्षसोत्सृष्टाञ्शरौघान्रावणानुजः
असम्भ्रान्तः प्रचिच्छेद निशितैर्बहुभिः शरैः |
verses.iast:
tatastānrākṣasotsṛṣṭāñśaraughānrāvaṇānujaḥ
asambhrāntaḥ praciccheda niśitairbahubhiḥ śaraiḥ |
verses.translation: Thereupon, Lakshmana coolly chopped off those gluts of arrows released by that foremost of demons, by the multitude of his sharp arrows.

glosses.meaning: released by the foremost of demons
by the multitude of his sharp arrows.

verses.devanagari:
ताञ्शरान्युधि सम्प्रेक्ष्य निकृत्तान्रावणात्मजः
चुकोप त्रिदशेन्द्रारिर्जग्राह निशितम् शरम् |
verses.iast:
tāñśarānyudhi samprekṣya nikṛttānrāvaṇātmajaḥ
cukopa tridaśendrārirjagrāha niśitam śaram |
verses.translation: That Atikaya, of great splendour, fixing that arrow to his bow and by instantly releasing it, struck the approaching Lakshmana in the middle of his chest.

glosses.meaning: the enemy of Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
स सन्धाय महातेजास्तं बाणम् सहसोत्सृजत्
ततः सौमित्रिमायान्तमाजघान स्तनान्तरे |
verses.iast:
sa sandhāya mahātejāstaṃ bāṇam sahasotsṛjat
tataḥ saumitrimāyāntamājaghāna stanāntare |
verses.translation: That Atikaya, of great splendour, fixing that arrow to his bow and by instantly releasing it, struck the approaching Lakshmana in the middle of his chest.

glosses.meaning: in the middle of his chest.

verses.devanagari:
अतिकायेन सौमित्रिस्ताडितो युधि वक्षसि
सुस्राव रुधिरम् तीव्रं मदं मत्त इव द्विपः |
verses.iast:
atikāyena saumitristāḍito yudhi vakṣasi
susrāva rudhiram tīvraṃ madaṃ matta iva dvipaḥ |
verses.translation: Struck in battle by Atikaya in his chest, Lakshmana oozed out blood severely, like the fluid exuding from a rutting elephant.

verses.devanagari:
स चकार तदात्मानम् विशल्यं सहसा विभुः
जग्राह च शरम् तीष्णमस्त्रेणापि समादधे |
verses.iast:
sa cakāra tadātmānam viśalyaṃ sahasā vibhuḥ
jagrāha ca śaram tīṣṇamastreṇāpi samādadhe |
verses.translation: That powerful Lakshmana, then quickly made himself freed from that arrow-head, took up a sharp arrow and fixed it with a missile.

verses.devanagari:
आग्नेयेन तदास्त्रेण योजयामास सायकम्
स जज्वाल तदा बाणो धनुश्चास्य महात्मनः |
verses.iast:
āgneyena tadāstreṇa yojayāmāsa sāyakam
sa jajvāla tadā bāṇo dhanuścāsya mahātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: When Lakshmana employed the missile of fire on his arrow, that arrow of the great souled Lakshmana and as also the bow, caused a flame to blaze.

glosses.meaning: that arrow of the great souled Lakshmana

verses.devanagari:
अतिकायोऽतितेजस्वी सौरमस्त्रम् समाददे
तेन बाणं भुजङ्गाभम् हेमपुङ्खमयोजयत् |
verses.iast:
atikāyo'titejasvī sauramastram samādade
tena bāṇaṃ bhujañgābham hemapuñkhamayojayat |
verses.translation: Atikaya of great splendour took up a solar missile and employed it on that arrow, having a golden shaft as also looking like a serpent.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तम् ज्वलितं घोरम् लक्ष्मणः शरमाहितम्
अतिकायाय चिक्षेप कालदण्डमिवान्तकः |
verses.iast:
tatastam jvalitaṃ ghoram lakṣmaṇaḥ śaramāhitam
atikāyāya cikṣepa kāladaṇḍamivāntakaḥ |
verses.translation: Meanwhile, Lakshmana hurled at Atikaya, that blazing and awful arrow employed with that mystic missile as Yama the lord of Death would hurl his rod of destruction.

glosses.meaning: as Yama the lord of Death

verses.devanagari:
आग्नेयेनाभिसम्युक्तम् दृष्ट्वा बाणं निशाचरः
उत्ससर्ज तदा बाणम् दीप्तम् सूर्यास्त्रयोजितम् |
verses.iast:
āgneyenābhisamyuktam dṛṣṭvā bāṇaṃ niśAcaraḥ
utsasarja tadā bāṇam dīptam sūryāstrayojitam |
verses.translation: Seeing that arrow charged with a mystic missile of fire, Atikaya the demon then released the awful arrow charged with the solar missile.

glosses.meaning: charged with a missile of fire nishaacharaH = the demon

verses.devanagari:
तावुभावम्बरे बाणावन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः
तेजसा सम्प्रदीप्ताग्रौ क्रुद्धाविव भुजम् गमौ |
verses.iast:
tāvubhāvambare bāṇāvanyonyamabhijaghnatuḥ
tejasā sampradīptāgrau kruddhāviva bhujam gamau |
verses.translation: Those two arrows, having their points blazed in splendour, struck at each other in the sky, like two enraged serpents.

glosses.meaning: with their points blazing in splendour

verses.devanagari:
तावन्योन्यम् विनिर्दह्य पेततुर्धरणीतले
निरर्चिषौ भस्मकृतौ न भ्राजेते शरोत्तमौ |
तावुभरु दीप्यमानौ स्म न भ्राजेते महीतले
verses.iast:
tāvanyonyam vinirdahya petaturdharaṇītale
nirarciṣau bhasmakṛtau na bhrājete śarottamau |
tāvubharu dīpyamānau sma na bhrājete mahītale
verses.translation: Those two excellent arrows, eventhough they were both blazing, did not radiate any longer on the earth's surface, in that they were without a flame and had been reduced to ashes.

verses.devanagari:
ततोऽतिकायः सङ्क्रुद्धस्त्वस्त्रमैषीकमुत्सृजत् |
तत्प्रचिच्छेद सौमित्रिरस्त्रमैन्द्रेण वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
tato'tikāyaḥ sañkruddhastvastramaiṣīkamutsṛjat |
tatpraciccheda saumitrirastramaindreṇa vīryavān
verses.translation: Thereupon, the enraged Atikaya released an arrow made of cane (a missile) presided over by Tvasha (the architect of gods). Then, the valiant LakShmana chopped off that missile, by his missile presided over by Indra the lord of celestials.

glosses.meaning: presided over by Tvashta (the architect of gods)
by his missile presided over by Indra the lord of celestials.

verses.devanagari:
ऐषीकं निहतम् दृष्ट्वा कुमारो रावणात्मजः |
याम्येनास्त्रेण सङ्क्रुद्धो योजयामास सायकम्
verses.iast:
aiṣīkaṃ nihatam dṛṣṭvā kumāro rāvaṇātmajaḥ |
yāmyenāstreṇa sañkruddho yojayāmāsa sāyakam
verses.translation: Seeing his arrow made of cane struck down, that young Atikaya was quite enraged and fixed his arrow with a missile presided over by Yama the lord of retribution.

glosses.meaning: with a missile presided over by Yama the lord of retribution.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तदस्त्रम् चिक्षेप लक्ष्मणाय निशाचरः |
वायव्येन तदस्त्रम् तु निजघान स लक्ष्मणः
verses.iast:
tatastadastram cikṣepa lakṣmaṇāya niśācaraḥ |
vāyavyena tadastram tu nijaghāna sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon, Atikaya hurled that missile on Lakshmana. That Lakshmana struck it down by a missile presided over by the wind-god.

glosses.meaning: by a missile presided over by the wind-god.

verses.devanagari:
अथैनम् शरधाराभिर्धाराभिरिव तोयदः |
अभ्यवर्षत सङ्क्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणो रावणात्मजम्
verses.iast:
athainam śaradhārābhirdhārābhiriva toyadaḥ |
abhyavarṣata sañkruddho lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇātmajam
verses.translation: Then, the furious Lakshmana showered forth hails of arrows on Atikaya, as a rainy cloud showers hails of down-pour.

verses.devanagari:
तेऽतिकायम् समासाद्य कवचे वज्रभूषिते |
भग्नाग्रशल्याः सहसा पेतुर्बाणा महीतले
verses.iast:
te'tikāyam samāsādya kavace vajrabhūṣite |
bhagnāgraśalyāḥ sahasā peturbāṇā mahītale
verses.translation: Reaching Atikaya, those arrows with the points of their shafts shattered on his armour, adorned with diamonds and instantly fell on the earth's surface.

glosses.meaning: with the points of their shafts shattered

verses.devanagari:
तान्मोघानभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा |
अभ्यवर्षत बाणानाम् सहस्रेण महायशाः
verses.iast:
tānmoghānabhisamprekṣya lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā |
abhyavarṣata bāṇānām sahasreṇa mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing those arrows becoming unsuccessful, the highly famous Lakshmana the annihilator of enemy-warriors, showered forth arrows in thousands.

verses.devanagari:
स वर्ष्यमाणो बाणौघैरतिकायो महाबलः |
अवध्यकवचः सङ्ख्ये राक्षसो नैव विव्यथे
verses.iast:
sa varṣyamāṇo bāṇaughairatikāyo mahābalaḥ |
avadhyakavacaḥ sañkhye rākṣaso naiva vivyathe
verses.translation: Atikaya, that mighty demon, though deluged with a flood of arrows, was not agitated in battle because of the inviolability of his armour.

glosses.meaning: because of the inviolability of is armour.

verses.devanagari:
शरं चाशीविषाकारं लक्ष्मणाय व्यपासृजत् |
स तेन विद्धः सौमित्रिर्मर्मदेशे शरेण ह
मुहूर्तमात्रं निःसम्ज्ञो ह्यभव च्छत्रुतापनः |
verses.iast:
śaraṃ cāśīviṣākāraṃ lakṣmaṇāya vyapāsṛjat |
sa tena viddhaḥ saumitrirmarmadeśe śareṇa ha
muhūrtamātraṃ niḥsamjJṇo hyabhava cchatrutāpanaḥ |
verses.translation: Atikaya released an arrow having a serpent-like form on Lakshmana. Struck by that arrow on his vital parts, that Lakshmana, the tormentator of his enemies, felt unconscious just for a moment.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सम्ज्ञामुपालभ्य चतुर्भिः सायतोत्तमैः
निजघान हयान् संख्ये सारथिम् च महाबलः |
ध्वजस्योन्मथनम् कृत्वा शरवर्षै ररिंदमः
verses.iast:
tataḥ samjJṇāmupālabhya caturbhiḥ sāyatottamaiḥ
nijaghāna hayān saṅkhye sārathim ca mahābalaḥ |
dhvajasyonmathanam kṛtvā śaravarṣai rariṃdamaḥ
verses.translation: Having regained his consciousness, the mighty Lakshmana, the annihilator of enemies, with his flood of arrows threw down the flag-staff and killed the horses and the charioteer in combat, with his four excellent arrows.

verses.devanagari:
असंभ्रान्तः स सौमित्रिस्तान् शरानभिलक्षितान् |
मुमोच लक्ष्मणो बाणान् वधार्थं तस्य रक्षसः
verses.iast:
asambhrāntaḥ sa saumitristān śarānabhilakṣitān |
mumoca lakṣmaṇo bāṇān vadhārthaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ
verses.translation: Free from flurry, that Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, released those arrows, exactly aiming at that demon, for the purpose of killing him.

verses.devanagari:
न शशाक रुजम् कर्तुम् युधि तस्य नरोत्तमः |
अथैनमभ्युपागम्य वायुर्वाक्यमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
na śaśāka rujam kartum yudhi tasya narottamaḥ |
athainamabhyupāgamya vāyurvākyamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Lakshmana, the best among men, was not able to afflict any injury to Atikaya in battle. Then, the wind-god came to him and spoke to him as follows:

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मदत्तवरो ह्येष अवध्य कवचावृतः |
ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण भिन्ध्येनमेष वध्यो हि नान्यथा
अवध्य एष ह्यन्येषामस्त्राणाम् कवची बली |
verses.iast:
brahmadattavaro hyeṣa avadhya kavacāvṛtaḥ |
brāhmeṇāstreṇa bhindhyenameṣa vadhyo hi nānyathā
avadhya eṣa hyanyeṣāmastrāṇām kavacī balī |
verses.translation: "He, endowed with a boon by Brahma the lord of creation, is cloaked by inviolable armour. Split him with a missile of Brahma. He cannot be killed by any other means. The mighty Atikaya, with that armour, cannot be destroyed by other missiles."

glosses.meaning: endowed with a boon by Brahma the lord of creation
is cloaked with an inviolable armour
cannot be killed anyathaa = by any other way

verses.devanagari:
ततः स वायोर्वचनं निशम्य |
सौमित्रिरिन्द्रप्रतिमानवीर्यः |
समाददे बाणममोघवेगं |
तद्ब्राह्ममस्त्रम् सहसा नियोज्य
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa vāyorvacanaṃ niśamya |
saumitririndrapratimānavīryaḥ |
samādade bāṇamamoghavegaṃ |
tadbrāhmamastram sahasā niyojya
verses.translation: Then, hearing the words of the wind-god, Lakshmana having a prowess equal to that of Indra the lord of celestials, adjusting his arrow with a missile presided over by Vrahma, quickly directed the arrow with a terrific force.

glosses.meaning: having a prowess equal to that of Indra

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन्वरास्त्रे तु नियुज्यमाने |
सौमित्रिणा बाणवरे शिताग्रे |
दिशः सचन्द्रार्कमहाग्रहाश् च |
नभश्च तत्रास ररास चोर्वी
verses.iast:
tasminvarāstre tu niyujyamāne |
saumitriṇā bāṇavare śitāgre |
diśaḥ sacandrārkamahāgrahāś ca |
nabhaśca tatrāsa rarāsa corvī
verses.translation: While fixing that excellent missile on that superior sharp-pointed arrow by Lakshmana, all the quarters, the sun, the moon, the great planets and the sky were frightened. Earth also made an uproar.

verses.devanagari:
तं ब्रह्मणोऽस्त्रेण नियुज्य चापे |
शरम् सुपुङ्खं यमदूतकल्पम् |
सौमित्रिरिन्द्रारिसुतस्य तस्य |
ससर्ज बाणम् युधि वज्रकल्पम्
verses.iast:
taṃ brahmaṇo'streṇa niyujya cāpe |
śaram supuñkhaṃ yamadūtakalpam |
saumitririndrārisutasya tasya |
sasarja bāṇam yudhi vajrakalpam
verses.translation: Having charged the missile of Brahma on that arrow with the feathers and all, equal to a messenger of Yama the lord of Death over his bow, Lakshmana released that arrow looking like a thunderbolt on Atikaya, the son of Ravana.

glosses.meaning: equal to a messenger of Yama the lord of Death

verses.devanagari:
तम् लक्ष्मणोत्सृष्टममोघवेगं |
समापतन्तम् ज्वलनप्रकाशम् |
सुवर्णवज्रोत्तमचित्रपुङ्खं |
तदातिकायः समरे ददर्श
verses.iast:
tam lakṣmaṇotsṛṣṭamamoghavegaṃ |
samāpatantam jvalanaprakāśam |
suvarṇavajrottamacitrapuñkhaṃ |
tadātikāyaḥ samare dadarśa
verses.translation: Atikaya saw that arrow, released with augmented force by Lakshmana, moving so fastly as the wind, having beautiful wings with variegated feathers and looking like a thunderous thunderbolt, approaching him in battle.

glosses.meaning: released with augmented force by Lakshmana
moving so fastly as the wind
having beautiful wings with variegated feathers

verses.devanagari:
तं प्रेक्षमाणः सहसातिकायो |
जघान बाणैर्निशितैरनेकैः |
स सायकस्तस्य सुपर्णवेगस् |
तदातिवेगेन जगाम पार्श्वम्
verses.iast:
taṃ prekṣamāṇaḥ sahasātikāyo |
jaghāna bāṇairniśitairanekaiḥ |
sa sāyakastasya suparṇavegas |
tadātivegena jagāma pārśvam
verses.translation: Seeing that arrow, Atikaya quickly struck with several sharp arrows. That Lakshmana's arrow, with a speed equal to Garuda the eagle, thus reached Atikaya's proximity.

glosses.meaning: with a speed equal to Garuda the eagle

verses.devanagari:
तमागतं प्रेक्ष्य तदातिकायो बाणं प्रदीप्तान्तककालकल्पम् |
जघान शक्त्यृष्टिगदाकुठारैः शूलैर्हलैश्चाप्यविपन्नचेष्टः
verses.iast:
tamāgataṃ prekṣya tadātikāyo bāṇaṃ pradīptāntakakālakalpam |
jaghāna śaktyṛṣṭigadākuṭhāraiḥ śūlairhalaiścāpyavipannaceṣṭaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that blazing arrow, looking like Yama the lord of Death and black in colour, approaching him, Atikaya then struck it with spike, spear, mace, axe and arrows.

glosses.meaning: blazing and looking like Yama the lord of Death and black in colour

verses.devanagari:
तान्यायुधान्यद्भुतविग्रहाणि |
मोघानि कृत्वा स शरोऽग्निदीप्तः |
प्रसह्य तस्यैव किरीटजुष्टं |
तदातिकायस्य शिरो जहार
verses.iast:
tānyāyudhānyadbhutavigrahāṇi |
moghāni kṛtvā sa śaro'gnidīptaḥ |
prasahya tasyaiva kirīṭajuṣṭaṃ |
tadātikāyasya śiro jahāra
verses.translation: Then, that arrow, blazing like fire, made in vain those weapons of wonderful form and taking Atikaya's head, carried it away.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छिरः सशिरस्त्राणम् लक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितम् |
पपात सहसा भूमौ शृङ्गम् हिमवतो यथा
verses.iast:
tacchiraḥ saśirastrāṇam lakṣmaṇeṣuprapīḍitam |
papāta sahasā bhUmau śṛñgam himavato yathā
verses.translation: That head with its diadem, chopped off by Lakshmana, quickly fell down on the ground, like a peak of the Himalayan Mountain.

verses.devanagari:
तं भूमौ पतितं दृष्ट्वा विक्षिप्ताम्बरभूषणम् |
बभूवुर्व्यथिताः सर्वे हरशेषा निशाचराः
verses.iast:
taṃ bhūmau patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṣiptāmbarabhūṣaṇam |
babhūvurvyathitāḥ sarve haraśeṣā niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Atikaya falling on the ground, with his clothes and ornaments scattered away, all the surviving demons became perturbed.

glosses.meaning: with his clothes and ornaments scattered away

verses.devanagari:
ते विषण्णमुखा दीनाः प्रहारजनितश्रमाः |
विनेदुरुच्चैर्बहवः सहसा विस्वरैः स्वरैः
verses.iast:
te viṣaṇṇamukhā dīnāḥ prahārajanitaśramāḥ |
vineduruccairbahavaḥ sahasā visvaraiḥ svaraiḥ
verses.translation: Many of those depressed demons, dejected as they were, showing fatigue born of fighting, in their faces, suddenly began to shout loudly, with their voices in discordant notes.

glosses.meaning: with a fatigue born of fighting

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तत्परितो याता निरपेक्षा निशाचराः |
पुरीमभिमुखा भीता द्रवन्तो नायके हते
verses.iast:
tatastatparito yātā nirapekṣā niśācarāḥ |
purīmabhimukhā bhītā dravanto nāyake hate
verses.translation: As their leader was dead, the demons were then frightened and becoming indifferent to fight, went running away all around, with their faces turned towards that City of Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
प्रहर्षयुक्ता बहवस्तु वानरा |
प्रबुद्धपद्मप्रतिमाननास्तदा |
अपूजयम्ल्लक्ष्मणमिष्टभागिनं |
हते रिपौ भीमबले दुरासदे
verses.iast:
praharṣayuktā bahavastu vānarā |
prabuddhapadmapratimānanāstadā |
apūjayamllakṣmaṇamiṣṭabhāginaṃ |
hate ripau bhīmabale durāsade
verses.translation: When the dangerous demon with the terrific strength was killed, the multitude of monkeys then were endowed with a great delight, with their faces looking like full blown lotuses and worshipped Lakshmana who got his desire fulfilled.

glosses.meaning: after the dangerous demon with terrific strength was killed
were endowed with a great delight
who was blessed with the fulfillment of his desire.

verses.devanagari:
अतिबल मतिकायमभ्रकल्पं |
युधि विनिपात्य स लक्ष्मणः प्रहृष्टः |
त्वरितमथ तदा स रामपार्श्वं
कपिनिवहैश्च सुपूजितो जगाम
verses.iast:
atibala matikāyamabhrakalpaṃ |
yudhi vinipātya sa lakṣmaṇaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ |
tvaritamatha tadā sa rāmapārśvaṃ
kapinivahaiśca supūjito jagāma
verses.translation: Throwing down in battle, that Atikaya who was exceedingly strong and looking like a cloud, Lakshmana was greatly delighted and while he was being worshipped by the multitude of monkeys, thereupon quickly hastened towards the proximity of Rama.

glosses.meaning: and while he was being worshipped
